events.name: Cincinnati Open
events.summary: A combined ATP Masters 1000 and WTA 1000 tournament, with both draws, daily schedules, rankings and followed-player controls in one place.
details: Community Weekend opened the tournament on 8-9 August before main-draw play began on 11 August.
The event concludes with finals weekend on 22-23 August. Published match times remain subject to the official order of play.

sources.name: ATP Tour — Fils wins the 2026 Cincinnati final
Cincinnati Open — Gauff claims second Cincinnati crown

editorialNarrative.hook: Fils left Cincinnati with a first Masters 1000 title, while Gauff's second crown reopened a proven road from Ohio to New York.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Arthur Fils returned from a long absence to become the youngest French Masters 1000 champion of the series era. Coco Gauff won Cincinnati for the second time and carried a genuine continuity line into the US Open: her first Cincinnati title in 2023 immediately preceded her first major, a precedent rather than a prediction.

events.name: US Open 2026
events.venue: USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center
events.summary: The final Grand Slam of 2026 runs for 22 days, from Fan Week and qualifying through the singles finals at Arthur Ashe Stadium.
details: Fan Week begins on 23 August and main-draw singles begin on 30 August.
The women's singles final is scheduled for 12 September and the men's singles final for 13 September.

Alcaraz and Rybakina return as first-time Australian Open champions, while capped early Ground Passes and the record 2026 audience add a real scale consequence without inventing entrants or seeds.

events.name: Formula 1 Australian Grand Prix 2027
events.summary: The 2027 Australian Grand Prix is confirmed for Albert Park, with race-weekend dates still unpublished on the verified ticket page.
details: The official Formula One ticketing endpoint currently offers a waitlist.
The event date remains TBC until a current Formula One or FIA calendar confirms it.

editorialNarrative.hook: Melbourne's 2027 return is certain; the date, ticket release and next Albert Park storyline are not.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Formula 1 is contracted to return to Melbourne through 2035, but the 2027 date and ticket packages remain unconfirmed. Albert Park's fast temporary-road character supplies durable context while the card remains explicitly TBC instead of turning a planning date into a fixture.
